title: Fable
tagline: Fable is toolkit for dropping binaural sounds to Tarots, through Prime Number Binaural Inspiration
description: The project aims to solve the problem of random oracles in the use of tarot systems, with the warmth of audio & play, while building with zora thought interactive mints on polygon. The interface will hopefully be adapted to hardware devices instead of web browsers, like oracle balls or marbles, infused with algae for voltaic production of energy to power a constant source of divination.
how_its_made: This project encompasses the use of react, solidity, and some code comments from the use of a partial implementation of an audio renderer. Where help is needed is forming key numbers to eventually get to the point of zknark like additions to place numerical figured audio constants for maximal integration of tarots for memory recall & transparency.
